text:
maya: Heads up — noticed a cluster of inbound leads (approx 2%) that never landed in SF/HubSpot owner queues yesterday. Looks like the demux rule returned 'no-route' when enrichment timer exceeded 25s. Anyone else see this?

liam: I saw the spike in unassigned leads at 11:20 PDT. Correlates with a retry storm from the enrichment lambda hitting a DB read timeout.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: enrichment-service v1.8.2 rolled 03:12 UTC — no rollbacks.

julia: Quick question: are these getting into a dead-letter or just left unassigned? Need to estimate SLA impact for MQL handoffs.

chris: Most show up in HubSpot without owner property set — so marketing flows don't claim them. Sales reported 7 missed outbound touches.

alex: Sharing the webhook snippet that routes leads:
```
if (lead.enrichment.status == 'complete' && lead.score >= 40) {
  assignRoundRobin('sdr_pool')
} else if (lead.enrichment.status == 'pending') {
  return 'hold_for_enrich'
} else {
  return 'no-route'
}
```
We don't currently have a fallback when enrichment stalls.

nora: I pulled the logs — enrichment had several 503s to vendor + two slow KV reads (avg 45s). Query:
```
SELECT id FROM enrichment_jobs WHERE lead_id = ? AND status != 'done' LIMIT 1;
-- returned rows with last_touch > 30s
```

liam: Proposal: add a short-circuit fallback route that assigns to a low-priority overflow SDR pool after X seconds (e.g., 20s) so leads aren't dropped. Also surface a hubspot property `pending_enrich_since` for observability.

julia: +1. For reporting we need a flag so we can retroactively audit handoff SLA breaches. Maybe set `handoff_status = "overflow_assigned"` so downstream dashboards treat it differently.

chris: Another idea — keep current round-robin, but skip members flagged as 'no_capacity' and add an exponential backoff retry for enrichment at 10s/30s. If still pending after 60s, push to overflow.

maya: Sounds sensible. Action items: liam to prototype fallback assign + hubspot property; alex to add `pending_enrich_since` in webhook; nora to produce a 24h query to quantify how many were affected; chris/julia to update SLA docs and downstream dashboards.

liam: I'll open a quick PR for the fallback logic tonight and add a feature flag (marketing.overflow_fallback). Will include tests for race between enrichment callback and fallback.

alex: I'll update the HubSpot workflow mapping. Proposed property mapping:
```
metadata.pending_enrich_since -> hs_pending_enrich_since
metadata.handoff_status -> hs_handoff_status
```
Also will add a webhook heartbeat to avoid 'no-route' when the enrichment system is in-flight.

nora: Query stub for audit (will run and post numbers):
```
SELECT count(*) FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
AND hs_handoff_status IS NULL
AND metadata.pending_enrich_since IS NOT NULL;
```

maya: Great — if we can ship feature flag + hubspot mapping by tomorrow morning we can run a weekend canary and avoid more missed touches. :thumbsup:

chris: FYI to sales: I'll message the SDR leads channel to expect a few overflow assignments while we test.

ops-bot: Incident tag created: #inbound-enrich-fallback-3050009999.

julia: Thanks all. Follow up in tomorrow's standup — please paste PR links and the audit numbers. :eyes:
